setup_steps: In HubSpot, open Development > MCP Connectors and create an MCP connector; copy its client id and client secret.

Add the remote server https://mcp.hubspot.com to Claude Code with your connector credentials, from the vault folder at project scope (--scope project, so scheduled reports can start it), following the official guide: https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/apps/developer-platform/build-apps/integrate-with-the-remote-hubspot-mcp-server
Complete the OAuth flow with a view-only HubSpot user (run /mcp in Claude Code).
verify: Ask Claude Code to run get_user_details and report which tools and objects are accessible.
read_only_mitigation: The server exposes write tools and no read-only mode is documented. Authorise with a view-only HubSpot user, decline optional write permissions at consent, and deny the write tools. Source: https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/apps/developer-platform/build-apps/integrate-with-the-remote-hubspot-mcp-server
